params.name: limit
params.description: Pagination parameter, use to specify the quantity of records returned

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination parameter, use to specify the number of records to skip before starting to return results

params.name: sortDirection
params.description: Pagination parameter, use to specify the order of records by creation date, either 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending

params.name: startDate
params.description: When you provide date-time value, time is ignored and will take the start of the day for the given date (00:00:00)

items.docs:
Returns requested shift with clinician's details and a link to download clinician profile that is generated when the shift was requested. This ensures the clinician information is up to date.

Users can also create a Webhook in our system to receive notifications when a clinician requests to work a shift.

Reject a Clinician's Shift Request

This operation rejects a clinician's request to take a shift.

Notifications

  • The clinician whose request was rejected will be notified that the shift has already been filled.

Shift Status Updates

  • The rejected clinician will see the shift marked as "Filled" in their view, indicating that the shift is no longer available for
